judgement.rule: A local (imported) list's menu on Find ends with Remove this list (trash icon, after every other row, Settings included); a built-in list's menu never has it. Its tap opens the confirm in a popup (showRemove); Remove takes off the phone the kept export, the list, its per-battle ticks, its Phase checklist boxes and its star (removeKept), then home with the toast. The Overview's Remove is unchanged and shares the confirm (rmAsk). No remove on the home screen's rows: each row already ends in its star, and a second icon would squeeze the name at 320px and put a one-tap destructive target next to the star.
